parameters.help_en: The query credential. Set the value to the NextToken value returned in the last API call

parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.
Maximum value: 50.
Default value: 10.
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。    
最大值为50。    
默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the ECI instance on which the CommitContainer task is performed.
You must specify this parameter or TaskId.
parameters.help_zh:
执行CommitContainer任务的ECI实例ID。    
查询时按实例ID或者任务ID进行查询，两者至少要填其中一个
parameters.name: container_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

- Running

- Succeeded

- Failed

任务状态。取值范围：

- Running：运行中
- Succeeded：成功
